headline: Colombian Economic Activity Grows 2.2% Annually Between August and October
summary: Colombia's productive economic activity grew 2.2% annually between August and October 2026, matching the growth rate of the previous quarter.
why: Gross domestic product and productivity indicators gauge macroeconomic performance, guiding investment and monetary policy in Latin America's major economies.
